description: Create or update a file in Nextcloud. Give text as it is; for a binary file (PDF, image, office document) give its bytes in base64 and set encoding to "base64". File size is limited (default 1 GB, configurable via MCP_MAX_FILE_SIZE). The limit counts the characters of content, so a base64 file can be about three quarters of it.

content.description: The content to write to the file: its text, or its bytes in base64 when encoding is "base64"

encoding.description: How content is given. "text" (default) stores it as it is. "base64" decodes it first, to write a binary file such as a PDF, an image or an office document

name: write_file
title: Write File
